# netcup_failover_ips (Data Source)

Failover IPs (v4 and v6) of the netcup account (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_failover_ips" "all" {}

output "failover_ipv4_addresses" {
  value = [for ip in data.netcup_failover_ips.all.ipv4 : ip.ip]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ipv4` (Attributes List) Failover IPv4s. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))
- `ipv6` (Attributes List) Failover IPv6s. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6))

<a id="nestedatt--ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Failover IP id.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address.
- `server_id` (Number) Currently routed server id (0 if none).


<a id="nestedatt--ipv6"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv6`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Failover IP id.
- `network_prefix` (String) IPv6 network prefix.
- `server_id` (Number) Currently routed server id (0 if none).
